name: io.github.aistoragedepot-admin/aistoragedepot-mcp
title: AIStorageDepot
description: Prompt, rules, skills & docs library over MCP. No token = read-only sample of the public library.

environmentVariables.name: AISD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your AIStorageDepot API token (Settings → API tokens). Leave it out and the server runs in free sample mode, serving a read-only slice of the public library — add it to get your own and your team's libraries.

environmentVariables.name: AISD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Only for the self-hosted edition: the origin of your own AIStorageDepot install, e.g. https://aisd.yourcompany.com. Defaults to the hosted service.
